messages.subject: Planned DMS maintenance — Saturday 22 March
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

The document management system will be unavailable from 18:00 on Saturday 22 March until approximately 02:00 Sunday for a scheduled upgrade. Please save and close all documents before you leave on Friday. Email will be unaffected.

Thanks,
IT Helpdesk
